title: Add sg.tips (dashboard)
body:
Adds `data/tools/sg-tips.yaml` (category `dashboard`). Data file only, no README in the diff. `python scripts/build.py --validate` passes locally.

sg.tips shows per-match Polymarket and Kalshi probabilities for sports markets, with public positions of screened accounts on each match. It also publishes a weekly aggregate dataset (CC BY 4.0, CSV): https://github.com/tipsstats/prediction-market-pro-stats

Access is marked `freemium`: match pages and probabilities are free without signup; some account-level views need a free login or membership.

Disclosure: this is my own work (I work on sg.tips).
